title: Linux Integration Test Environment Reconciliation
objective: Remove the Linux-only backend integration test failures without changing business logic or deploy/runtime configuration.

cause.summary: The Linux suites were coupled to Prisma/environment bootstrap at import time. A disposable Linux run showed DATABASE_URL validation and Prisma engine initialization failures outside the test intent.

targetedLinuxSuites.command: docker run --rm -v "${PWD}\\backend:/app" -w /app node:20-bookworm-slim npm run test -- src/tests/integration/edp.runtime.e2e.test.ts src/tests/integration/edp.persistence.prisma.test.ts src/tests/integration/simulation-runtime-evidence.http.test.ts src/tests/integration/simulation-runtime-evidence.persistence.prisma.test.ts

fullLinuxSuite.command: docker run --rm -v "${PWD}\\backend:/app" -w /app node:20-bookworm-slim npm run test
fullLinuxSuite.note: The remaining failures were Prisma/libssl bootstrap issues outside the four scoped suites.
